integrity: A complete mathematical proof of the global maximum and all extremizing spectra is supplied, with an independently executable finite test. Finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact linear binary adjacent-pair multispectra only; existing per-profile fiber formulas are acknowledged as prior knowledge. An unindexed proof of the global optimization cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp worst-case ambiguity and extremal profiles of binary length-two multispectra
